rationale: SNRI-to-SNRI swap, often considered when venlafaxine causes dose-dependent hypertension, sexual dysfunction, or insufficient response. Both drugs share serotonergic and noradrenergic activity; cross-taper can be brief but venlafaxine's very high discontinuation-syndrome risk requires a graded reduction. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start duloxetine 30 mg. Hold venlafaxine XR 150 mg.
Halve venlafaxine to 75 mg XR. Hold duloxetine 30 mg. Watch for serotonergic excess (tremor, hyperreflexia) and discontinuation symptoms.
Reduce venlafaxine to 37.5 mg XR. Increase duloxetine to 60 mg target.
Stop venlafaxine. Continue duloxetine 60 mg. If discontinuation symptoms emerge, slow the final step.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: venlafaxine 150 mg XR ≈ duloxetine 60 mg. Equivalency is approximate; titrate to clinical response. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
